Natural human anatomy, simplified yet believable facial planes, small ordinary eyes, carefully observed nose and lips, soft natural asymmetry. Period literary illustration, not a modern romantic fantasy character. The Dreamer: a Russian young man aged 26, slim and slightly weary, clean shaven. Three-quarter view facing RIGHT, looking toward the other character. Medium brown hair, modest natural side part, loosely combed rather than spiky or voluminous; slightly high forehead. Narrow but naturally rounded jaw, defined straight nose with real nostrils, grey eyes with subtle under-eye shadows, gently uneven brows, thin expressive lips. Thoughtful, shy and tender, an ordinary believable adult rather than an idealized teenage hero. Worn slate-blue frock coat, brown waistcoat, high ivory shirt collar and loosely tied dark neckcloth.
